info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Counterparty Risk Assessment API
info.description: The Counterparty Risk Assessment API provides financial institutions with essential insights into the risk associated with engaging counterparties. This API enables users to retrieve in-depth assessments of potential risks linked to specific counterparties, facilitating informed decision-making in banking operations. Typical consumers include risk managers and compliance teams seeking to evaluate the creditworthiness and reliability of counterparties. By leveraging this API, organizations can effectively mitigate risks and enhance their risk management strategies.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about counterparty risk. Utilize it to evaluate the financial stability and reliability of business partners effectively.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve counterparty risk details for account management. This request requires specific criteria to fetch relevant data.

200.description: Successful retrieval of counterparty risk data.
